```plato
    // How one triangle re-triangulates when some of its edges carry a new midpoint.
    // v0, v1, v2 are the corners in winding order; m0 sits on v0-v1, m1 on v1-v2
    // and m2 on v2-v0, each the "none" index when that edge was not split. Every
    // emitted triangle keeps the original winding.
    // Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Winding, handedness, and normals.
    SplitFaceTriangles(v0: VertexIndex, v1: VertexIndex, v2: VertexIndex,
                       m0: VertexIndex, m1: VertexIndex, m2: VertexIndex): Array<TriangleFace>
    {
        var s0 = m0.IsPresent;
        var s1 = m1.IsPresent;
        var s2 = m2.IsPresent;
        return s0.And(s1).And(s2)
            ? [TriangleFace(v0, m0, m2), TriangleFace(m0, v1, m1),
               TriangleFace(m2, m1, v2), TriangleFace(m0, m1, m2)]
            : (s0.And(s1)
            ? [TriangleFace(m0, v1, m1), TriangleFace(v0, m0, m1), TriangleFace(v0, m1, v2)]
            : (s1.And(s2)
            ? [TriangleFace(m1, v2, m2), TriangleFace(v0, v1, m1), TriangleFace(v0, m1, m2)]
            : (s0.And(s2)
            ? [TriangleFace(v0, m0, m2), TriangleFace(m0, v1, v2), TriangleFace(m0, v2, m2)]
            : (s0 ? [TriangleFace(v0, m0, v2), TriangleFace(m0, v1, v2)]
            : (s1 ? [TriangleFace(v0, v1, m1), TriangleFace(v0, m1, v2)]
            : (s2 ? [TriangleFace(v0, v1, m2), TriangleFace(m2, v1, v2)]
            : [TriangleFace(v0, v1, v2)]))))));
    }
```
